variant: guarded_projected_newton_v1; existing affine real Family and Hamiltonians unchanged; no adoption of partner assembly optimization in this checkpoint

partner_source.credit: Partner engine study supplied by Alan Fuller; preserve original bytes. Adapt the projected-derivative Newton idea with explicit safeguards; keep the original failure behavior as a regression comparison.

primary_cases: 17 retained D stations from 38 to 39, three roots p/q/upper, two seed choices per root, both engines: 204 cases. Offset seed = retained root + (0.002,-0.001). Carried seed = previous retained station root; at first station use retained root + (-0.002,0.001). These are sampled comparisons, not continuous node identity.
reference: Unchanged r1_events Solver.root via r1_holonomy Family.solver. Count every eig invocation, including numerical Jacobian evaluations. Compare identical input seeds, alternate execution order to reduce systematic timing bias. Timing is descriptive, never an acceptance gate.
newton: Use current isolated pair eigenframe F, projected matrices F.T A_j F, and the local two-component traceless Jacobian. This is a frozen-frame linearization at each step, not the exact Jacobian of the existing anchor-aligned residual. Limit steps and require actual-gap decrease by backtracking. Check finite real symmetric coefficients, finite inputs/eigensolutions, frame orthogonality, local box, exterior gaps and anchor overlap. Reject non-simple final roots with a singular-value and condition-number gate.
fallback: On Newton iteration/conditioning/step failure use bounded least squares on the unchanged anchor-aligned two-component residual formula within the original seed box. Keep the original seed anchor. Guard every fallback evaluation for domain, isolation and overlap; final acceptance additionally checks the Jacobian. Invalid model/input and an invalid initial pair do not fall back. Preserve all attempts and failure reasons.
forced_fallback: Six extra N8 cases: D38 p/q/upper in both engines with Newton iteration budget zero. All must use and pass the guarded fallback.
stress: Reuse the local N8 merger box [0.765,0.793] x [0.585,0.632]. Test both stored D40.38 upper roots at D40.38 and the stored fold coordinate at D40.40 in both engines. At D40.40 a failed root is retained as a failed search, never root absence. Native matrix checks at both D values verify the affine extrapolation. Stress results are reported separately from primary coverage.

scope: Solver-equivalence and bounded-search diagnostics in the finite R1 model. No new topology measurement, continuous node-identity proof, full braid acceptance, Euler-class change, physical validation or infinite-cutoff conclusion. Both engines share the diagnostic. Exact Hamiltonian derivatives do not by themselves provide uniform uniqueness bounds.
